_fill_in: A TEMPLATE for ophanim/operate/live-run.mjs (schema ophanim.live-run/v1). Copy it OUTSIDE the repository and fill it in. Every limit is null here ON PURPOSE: the owner chooses each one, and the launcher refuses a null (it fills in no default). limits: total_provider_calls = the whole run's provider-call cap (calls, not dollars; one agy worker call is a whole multi-turn session on the subscription); stage_provider_calls = per claimed stage, at most the total; revisions = per-file revisions (used only without work units); stage_attempts = retries of one stage on the same inputs; elapsed_ms = the wall-clock bound of the run; pipeline.max_provider_calls (at most stage_provider_calls), pipeline.max_revisions (implementer attempts after the first, per unit), pipeline.max_concurrent_units, pipeline.verify_timeout_ms. billing.metered_gemini_failover: false = a lane quota refusal blocks the unit instead of calling the metered Gemini API (then credentials.gemini_api_key is "not-used"); true = allowed (then "required"). require_subagent (optional; delete it if not part of acceptance): the run is not accepted without min_calls answered subagent calls of that role served by that model. ledgers.status_root is opened read-only; ledgers.work_root must be empty or absent (an isolated single-item work ledger is created there). out_dir is outside the repository. candidate_commit is the full HEAD the run is made against. Run with --dry-run first; then --confirm-spend "<item>@<first 7 of candidate_commit>".

billing.scope: replace: what this run may bill, in the owner's words
